characters.notes: Came through Whitebridge about a week ago asking after the same people the Myrddraal seeks, especially 'three country boys.' Identity unknown but clearly connected to the hunt. Possibly a Darkfriend or someone driven mad by the Shadow's influence. Went toward Caemlyn.

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray approaching Whitebridge, then in the town at The Wayfarers' Rest, fleeing through the square when the Myrddraal attacks, then on the road toward Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Tries to play Thom's flute poorly; argues with Mat and Thom about whether to continue to Caemlyn or flee to Illian; gathers information from innkeeper Bartim; flees when Gelb is overhead and then when the Myrddraal appears; watches Thom sacrifice himself to the Fade; escapes Whitebridge with Mat carrying Thom's bundled cloak and instruments
appearances.demeanor: Determined to reach Tar Valon and learn what is happening to him despite his fear; homesick when handling his father's sword; increasingly frightened but resolved; traumatized by Thom's death

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray, then in Whitebridge at The Wayfarers' Rest, fleeing through town and onto the Caemlyn road
appearances.notable_actions: Fails at playing the flute; argues they should accept that their friends might be dead; grips the Shadar Logoth dagger when angry at Thom, nearly threatening him with it; suggests going back to the boat but then flees with Rand when the Myrddraal appears
appearances.demeanor: Paranoid, suspicious of everyone, quick to anger, nervous and jumpy, affected by the evil of the dagger; declares everyone might be dead but follows Rand anyway

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray teaching the boys gleeman skills, then in Whitebridge gathering supplies and information, then in the square confronting the Myrddraal
appearances.notable_actions: Tries to teach Mat to play the flute; argues the boys should flee to Illian instead of continuing to Caemlyn; gathers intelligence at The Wayfarers' Rest; learns of the crazy man and the Myrddraal hunting them; acquires a disguise cloak; tells the boys about his nephew Owyn and why he helps them; sacrifices himself by attacking the Myrddraal to give Rand and Mat time to escape; screams as he fights the Fade in a flash of blue light
appearances.demeanor: Professional and instructive at first; increasingly urgent and frightened as danger closes in; conflicted about his involvement but ultimately self-sacrificing and heroic; reveals deep guilt over his nephew's fate

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray approaching and docking at Whitebridge
appearances.notable_actions: Commands the crew as they dock; discusses the White Bridge with Rand; dismisses Gelb from his crew for sleeping on watch; offers Thom money and passage to Illian to perform; plans to sail at first light the next morning
appearances.demeanor: Gruff but fair captain; skeptical of Aes Sedai works but acknowledges the bridge's utility; firm in his authority

appearances.whereabouts: On the Spray being dismissed, then in The Wayfarers' Rest spreading stories
appearances.notable_actions: Dismissed from the crew by Captain Domon; leaves the ship with visible hatred toward Rand and his friends; goes to the inn and loudly tells anyone who will listen about Trollocs chasing three Darkfriends, trying to implicate Rand, Mat, and Thom
appearances.demeanor: Hateful, vengeful, poisonous; seeking revenge by denouncing the boys as Darkfriends; desperate for someone to believe his story

appearances.whereabouts: At The Wayfarers' Rest inn in Whitebridge
appearances.notable_actions: Serves the boys spiced wine; tells them news of Logain being captured and the Hunt for the Horn being proclaimed; reluctantly reveals information about the weaselly crazy man and the Myrddraal who have been asking after the same people; tries to get Thom to perform at his inn; becomes frightened and asks them to leave when he realizes they are the ones being hunted; eavesdrops on Gelb's story
appearances.demeanor: Initially jovial and talkative; becomes increasingly fearful and evasive when discussing the Myrddraal; terrified of both Aes Sedai and the Fade; self-interested and protective of his business

appearances.notable_actions: Appears suddenly in the square approaching Rand, Mat, and Thom; stalks toward them with predatory confidence; begins to draw its black sword when Thom attacks; fights Thom with a flash of blue light while Thom screams; presumably kills Thom
appearances.demeanor: Predatory, confident, terrifying; enjoys the fear it creates; deliberate and unhurried in its approach; surprised when Thom attacks

appearances.notable_actions: None in this chapter; died years ago after getting in trouble with Aes Sedai

appearances.whereabouts: Passed through Whitebridge about a week ago, went toward Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Asked about the same people the Myrddraal seeks, especially three country boys and the fighting man and woman in silk; exhibited erratic, contradictory behavior; talked to himself; alternated between saying he had to wait and saying he had to hurry; left toward Caemlyn the same day he arrived
appearances.demeanor: Crazy, erratic, unstable; whining and begging one moment, demanding like a king the next; crying and talking to himself; desperate to find the boys

appearances.whereabouts: Captured near Lugard, being taken north to Tar Valon via Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Led an army from Ghealdan toward Tear before being captured in a great battle; being displayed in villages and towns as a captive false Dragon
None; only mentioned as the Queen they will show Logain to

relationships.description: Owyn was Thom's nephew, his brother's only son and his only living kin. Thom feels guilty for not helping Owyn when he got in trouble with Aes Sedai, and Owyn later died. This guilt motivates Thom to protect Rand and Mat.
Thom teaches Rand gleeman skills and protects him from the Shadow, ultimately sacrificing his life. Thom sees helping Rand as atonement for failing his nephew Owyn.
Thom teaches Mat gleeman skills and protects him, though Mat's paranoia from the dagger makes their relationship tense. Thom sacrifices himself to save Mat as well as Rand.
Childhood friends from the Two Rivers fleeing together; their relationship is strained by Mat's corruption from the Shadar Logoth dagger but they remain loyal to each other.
Father and son; Rand carries Tam's sword and feels intense homesickness when holding it, wondering if he will ever see Tam or home again.
Gelb blames Rand for his dismissal from the Spray and spreads stories identifying him as a Darkfriend, seeking revenge.
Gelb includes Mat in his accusations of being a Darkfriend, seeking revenge for his dismissal.
Gelb includes Thom in his accusations, claiming all three are Darkfriends.
The Fade hunts Rand specifically, asking after three country boys; confronts him in Whitebridge square.
The Fade hunts Mat as one of the three country boys.
Thom attacks the Myrddraal to save the boys; they fight and the Fade presumably kills Thom.
Captain and passenger; Domon pays Thom for entertaining the crew and offers him further passage and employment.
The crazy man is desperately seeking Rand as one of three country boys, though his motives and allegiance are unclear.
The crazy man seeks Mat as one of the three country boys.
